name: Shasei Hime Emuria ~Shokushu Choukyou ni Ochiru Futanari Oujo
original_name: 射精姫エムリア～触手調教に堕ちるフタナリ王女
source:
To save the King from the curse, the princess Emelia headed towards the house of the witch in the deep forest.
The witch promised to break the spell, however in return she asked the princess to become her sl*ve.
For her father, she reveals her extraordinary body...
